content:
In manateecreeksheep data/flock_database.json, status_date values of "2026-04-02" AND "2026-04-06" are bulk-cleanup placeholders from a prior DB sweep — they are NOT real death dates.

(Extends prior memory 3eb1220b which named 2026-04-02 specifically; this adds 2026-04-06 and additional cases.)

Confirmed cases as of 2026-04-26:
- `sam`: status_date was 2026-04-02; real death = Hurricane Helene 2024-09-26 (operator: "sam died in helene.")
- `broken-tail-twin-ewe-2` (MC-2601): status_date was 2026-04-06 (status="alive"); real death = 2026-04-22 parasites (owner-reported)
- Per docs/sheep_visual_id_process.md: `lara` and `half-tail` also bulk-marked deceased 2026-04-02 — lara is actually alive; half-tail died in Helene

Rule: when investigating a record with either of these dates, ALWAYS ask the operator for the real date and cause.
